description: This file is a shell script containing tests for Git's whitespace fixing functionality during rebase operations. It sets up test cases to verify the behavior of 'git rebase --whitespace=fix' with different whitespace scenarios and configurations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines to a file; used in test setup.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of all test cases.
